rationale: The agent found that plate is confounded with case status, with plates 1-2 mostly cases and plates 3-4 mostly controls. It measured that plate alone gives AUROC 0.82, close to the 0.85 from the full protein model, and that plate-corrected AUROC falls to about 0.52. It declined to report the naive number as a trustworthy result and proposed randomizing cases and controls across plates or validating on a replication cohort, which matches the key.
